description: The rational-cut embedding preserves addition and negation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower_add_neg (p q : ℚ) :
  Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower (p + q) =
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.cutAdd (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower p)
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower q) ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower (-p) =
      Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.cutNeg (Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.rationalLower p)
